question:
Select the most appropriate option for the given blank.

You appear healthy, although you have ___ some weight.
solution:
The correct answer is '**gained**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**gained**" means to increase in amount, size, or degree. (वजन बढ़ाना)
 
• In the context of weight, "gained" is the most appropriate word to use.
 
• The other options: "**win**," "**pick**," and "**build**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *You appear healthy, although you have gained__ some weight.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Win (जीतना)**: means to be successful or victorious in a contest or conflict.
 
• **Pick (चुनना)**: means to select from a group or to gather.
 
• **Build (निर्माण करना)**: means to construct or form by assembling parts.
